instructions: This is a missing-content checklist. Checked means the scoped writing, table, or figure is present, not that submission review is finished. Keep CHECKLIST-BEGIN/END markers and figure labels. Figures include their linked results paragraphs. Fill bracketed table values from the final input/result records. Review notes remain visible in details but do not block completed writing. Never invent values or erase outstanding work to raise the count.
